name: Bolesław II the Bold
role: Duke of Poland; King of Poland

checks.lead: Bolesław II the Bold (Polish: Bolesław II Śmiały; c. 1042 – 2 or 3 April 1081 or 1082), also known as the Generous (Szczodry ), was Duke of Poland from 1058 to 1076 and King of Poland from 1076 to 1079. He was the eldest son of Duke Casimir I the Restorer and Maria Dobroniega of Kiev.
